title: No test: max_bytes=0 with empty (complete) UU block returns is_truncated=false
description: uuencoding/src/decode.rs: decode_limited_zero_limit test uses a non-empty block (Cat/3 bytes). A contributor reading the test may assume max=0 always yields is_truncated=true. But an empty block (begin/space/end) with max=0 correctly returns is_truncated=false because the block is genuinely complete. This is surprising but correct. Add a test: decode_limited_zero_limit_empty_block to document the behavior and prevent a 'bug' report.
